# AGENTS.md instructions for <repo>

<INSTRUCTIONS>
<!-- [teamai:team-rules:start] -->
<!-- DO NOT EDIT: This section is auto-managed by teamai -->

# Engineering Safety

- 先确认任务范围、验收标准、数据来源和验证方式；业务语义不清时先询问。
- 优先采用目标仓库已有框架、库、目录、组件、请求层和样式方案。
- 只改当前任务需要的文件，不做无关重构、批量格式化或目录迁移。
- 不猜接口字段，不新增多 key 回退、别名字段或默认推断兼容。
- 不提交密钥、内网凭据、调试代码、未使用代码或本机绝对路径。
- 结束前运行与风险匹配的现有检查；失败和未执行项必须明确报告。

Applies to files matching: src/**, vite.config.*, package.json, unocss.config.*
# Frontend Mobile Runtime

- 适用于移动 Web、H5、WebView、活动页和消费端旅程，不按业务仓库名区分规则。
- UI 框架、viewport/rem 口径、safe-area、legacy/polyfill、别名、列表加载模式和 storage 工具以当前仓库配置为准，不套用 PC 组件、分页或权限约定。
- 修改启动、路由、登录、游客态、站点、回跳或请求链路时，先识别当前仓库唯一身份来源和初始化顺序，不建立平行状态链路。
- 支付、分享、OAuth、定位、媒体和 App Bridge 必须在真实域名、容器或设备环境验证；无法验证时明确披露。
- 移动列表复用当前仓库的 refresh/loading/finished 状态模型，处理触底、刷新、空态、失败和重复请求。
- 兼容性以 browserslist、build target、legacy 配置和实际 WebView 为准，不继承 PC 浏览器基线。

Applies to files matching: src/**, vite.config.*, package.json
# Frontend PC Runtime

- 适用于桌面管理、运营、配置和数据工作台，不按业务仓库名区分规则。
- UI 框架、自动导入、路径别名、权限指令、分页 Hook 和组件目录必须从当前仓库配置与相邻代码确认；不得把某个 PC 仓库的名称或目录约定提升为全部 PC 项目的硬规则。
- 菜单、路由和敏感操作使用同一权限来源；按钮隐藏不能替代服务端鉴权。
- 表格、表单、批量操作、导入导出和持久侧栏等桌面交互应复用当前仓库已有抽象。
- 浏览器基线以当前仓库 browserslist、构建 target 和交付环境为准；缺失时才把 Chrome 90+、Edge 90+、Safari 15+ 作为待确认的团队参考线。
- 若仓库存在 AI、可视化、编辑器或其他独立边界脚本，按仓库实际脚本执行，不把其目录名和命令复制到其他 PC 仓库。

Applies to files matching: src/api/**, src/views/**/*.vue, src/stores/**, src/hooks/**
# Frontend API Contract

- API 调用必须经过当前仓库现有 request 封装和 API 模块；函数命名、目录和客户端实例以仓库事实为准，不在组件内创建平行请求层。
- 只使用需求、接口文档或现有代码明确给出的字段和 request options。
- 禁止为未知字段写 `a || b || c`、别名映射、默认推断或隐式兼容。
- 高风险参数变更先记录 `field -> source`，特别是积分规则、策略画布、商城下单、支付和权限场景。
- 异步操作显式管理 loading，并在 `finally` 中复位；失败后的数据、空态、禁用和重复提交行为必须明确，不能依赖偶然残留状态。
- 路由、按钮、请求的权限或身份语义沿用目标项目已有来源，不发明新的权限 key、游客态或资格判断链路。
- 页面私有状态留在组件；只有确需跨页面共享的状态进入 Pinia。

Applies to files matching: src/**/*.vue, src/**/*.scss, src/styles/**, unocss.config.js, uno.config.js
# Component And Style Boundaries

- 页面负责接口编排、路由联动和状态组织；页面私有组件放在页面附近，跨业务复用后再进入共享组件目录。
- 可复用组件优先受控，默认通过 `props + emit` 通信，不在子组件中隐式修改父级状态。
- 组件输入显式命名、输出事件表达动作；输入输出格式保持稳定，接口数据转换由边界清晰的一层负责。
- 表单、表格、弹窗等多重职责明显混杂，或单文件接近 600 行且已影响阅读时，按业务职责拆分；行数只作为信号，不为拆分而拆分。
- 简单布局、间距和字号可使用项目已配置的 UnoCSS；复杂状态和第三方组件覆盖使用局部 SCSS。
- 组件样式默认 scoped；深层覆盖使用 `:deep()`，不使用 `>>>`、`/deep/` 或 `::v-deep`。
- 全局样式只承载 reset、布局、主题变量、UI 框架全局覆盖和真正通用的 class；页面样式不得写入全局入口。
- 复用现有主题变量、组件、图标和 `src/assets` 资源，不引入第二套 UI、图标或样式体系。
- 修改公共组件时检查调用方影响，并同步更新已有组件文档。

Applies to files matching: src/**, vite.config.js, package.json
# Frontend Runtime And Security

- 禁止新增 `eval`、`new Function` 或来源不明的远程脚本、CDN、域名资源和个人 key。
- `v-html`、`innerHTML`、Markdown 和富文本渲染必须追踪内容来源与净化边界；未知或未净化内容不得直接进入 HTML sink。
- 登录、身份、站点和业务状态使用项目已有 storage 工具；不把敏感信息随手写入 `localStorage` 或 `sessionStorage`。
- `URL.createObjectURL` 创建的 URL 在使用结束后调用 `URL.revokeObjectURL`；文件预览、下载、复制、媒体和浏览器 API 按目标运行环境验证。
- 新 Web API、CSS 能力和 polyfill 以目标项目的 Vite target、legacy 配置、browserslist 与实际 WebView 为准，不套用跨平台兼容假设。
- 编辑器、图表、可视化和其他重模块优先复用现有异步加载与 chunk 策略；新增依赖前确认现有能力、bundle 影响和按需引入方式。

Applies to files matching: src/**/*.vue, src/**/*.js, src/**/*.scss, vite.config.js, unocss.config.js, uno.config.js
# Vue 3 JavaScript Baseline

- `.eslintrc*`、`.prettierrc*`、Vite/UnoCSS 配置和相邻代码是格式、自动导入与目录约定的执行来源；不在 TeamAI 中维护第二套机械格式规则。
- 当前 VibotCode 项目以 JavaScript 为主，不主动新增 TypeScript 文件或语法。
- Vue SFC 优先使用 `<script setup>`；响应式状态优先 `ref`，大对象且不依赖深层响应时考虑 `shallowRef`。
- `computed` 只做派生，不做副作用；避免在模板中直接堆叠 `filter`、`map`、`sort` 等复杂表达式。
- `v-if` 与 `v-for` 不在同一元素混用。
- 事件处理函数使用 `handleXxx`；列表和详情函数使用带业务语义的名称。
- 重复业务字面量和状态值收敛到项目已有常量目录或目标模块常量，不为一次使用制造全局枚举。
- 注释解释来源、边界和原因；hooks、utils 或复杂公共函数存在非显然契约时补充 JSDoc，不要求给自解释的局部代码写叙述性注释。
- 自动导入、组件注册、路径别名和 SFC block 顺序以目标项目配置和相邻文件为准。

# VibotCode Frontend Review Gate

- 使用 `frontend-code-review` Skill 作为审查流程和输出协议的唯一来源。
- Workflow 的非空 `scope` 输入或用户显式审查范围优先，并覆盖默认基线；未指定时按 `origin/pre...HEAD` 审查已提交增量，缺少可用 `pre` 基线时再询问用户。
- Workflow 的非空 `requirements`、`context` 输入用于需求、验收标准、API 映射、PR 描述和风险说明；两者均为空时继续规范与运行风险审查，并披露无法完整验证需求行为的缺口。
- 先读取目标仓库 `AGENTS.md`、平台规则、平台文档、实际脚本/清单和必要的相邻代码，再判断变更。
- 单一运行端审查只加载一个平台画像：PC Web、移动 Web 或小程序。跨平台审查必须按目标分别标注，不能混用 DOM、路由、组件、存储、权限或兼容约束。
- 只报告由增量引入、修改、变为可达或明显恶化的问题，不把历史债务转成当前变更问题。
- 结论统一使用 `MustFix`、`ShouldFix`、`NiceToHave`。正式问题必须包含置信度、位置、增量归属、规则编号、证据、影响和聚焦的修复方向。
- 低可信度但重要的外部契约问题放入待确认事项，不作为正式问题；没有发现时明确说明残余验证或上下文缺口。
- 格式化和可由现有静态工具可靠发现的问题交给项目工具，只报告与本次改动行直接相关的真实诊断或质量门禁缺失。

# VibotCode Project Selection

- 当前工作区的前后端目录都是独立 Git 项目，命令、依赖、模块边界、运行时组件和配置不能跨项目假设。
- 进入业务目录后先读该项目 `AGENTS.md`、`.ai/standards/`、`README.md`、构建清单和相邻实现；不存在的文件不要臆造。
- Web 前端重点核对 `package.json`、构建/样式配置、路由、API 与组件体系；小程序重点核对应用清单、页面/分包、平台配置和目标基础库。
- 后端重点核对根/模块 POM、启动模块、包结构、数据库/MQ/缓存/任务实现和当前测试入口。
- 前端按运行端选择 `frontend-pc`、`frontend-mobile` 或 `frontend-mini-program`，不按仓库名创建项目画像，也不跨平台套用组件、路由、存储或兼容规则。
- `center-platform`、`center-manage`、`center-mall` 是单模块 MVC 服务；`center-gateway` 是 WebFlux 网关；`center-point`、`center-vip`、`center-chain` 是 COLA 多模块服务；`xxl-job` 是定制调度平台。不要跨架构套用分层和阻塞模型。
- 选择匹配的平台或后端 TeamAI project 后再开发；无法确认前端运行端时，只使用通用规则与当前仓库事实，并先完成平台识别。

<!-- [teamai:team-rules:end] -->

<!-- [teamai:claudemd:start] -->
<!-- DO NOT EDIT: This section is auto-managed by teamai -->

# Team Working Agreement

- 先读取目标仓库的 `AGENTS.md`、`README.md`、`package.json`、构建配置和相邻代码。
- 用户要求、仓库事实和相邻代码优先于团队通用建议。
- 只做当前任务需要的最小完整改动，不改无关文件，不猜接口字段。
- 完成前按风险运行现有验证；未运行或失败的验证必须如实说明。
- Git 写操作、依赖引入、权限与数据契约变更需要明确影响范围。

# VibotCode Context

VibotCode 工作区包含多个前端仓库和 8 个 Java 后端项目，全部是独立 Git 仓库。进入任一仓库后，以该仓库的 `AGENTS.md`、`.ai/standards/`、构建清单和相邻代码为最终依据。

- 前端不按仓库名选择 TeamAI project，而按运行端选择 `frontend-pc`、`frontend-mobile` 或 `frontend-mini-program`。平台画像只约束运行端差异；API、路由、自动导入、组件、环境变量和验证命令始终从当前仓库读取。
- 后端：`center-platform`、`center-manage`、`center-mall` 为单模块 MVC；`center-gateway` 为 WebFlux 网关；`center-point`、`center-vip`、`center-chain` 为 COLA 多模块；`xxl-job` 为定制 admin/core 调度平台。不要跨架构套用分层、阻塞模型或构建命令。
- TeamAI `0.30.0` 会合并当前 Role 与 Project 声明的 namespace。Role 提供开发或审查能力，Project 只提供平台或服务上下文；原始 CLI 不校验两者是否属于合法业务组合，错误组合可能把一种职责能力与无关项目上下文同时投递。必须按团队组合表选择，并优先使用 `scripts/setup-workspace.ps1` 拒绝非法组合。
- PC/移动 Web 开发使用 `frontend`，微信原生小程序开发使用 `frontend-mini-program`，后端开发使用 `backend`；前端审查使用 `frontend-review`，后端审查使用 `backend-review`，仅通用资料治理使用 `common`。

<!-- [teamai:claudemd:end] -->

## Team Knowledge Recall (teamai)

> **Self-exemption (must read first):** If you ARE the `teamai-recall` subagent yourself, this rule does NOT apply to you — do not invoke `teamai-recall` (or any recall) again. Proceed directly to performing the knowledge search that is your task. This prevents infinite subagent recursion in tools (e.g. Cursor) whose always-apply rules leak into subagent sessions.
>
> **自豁免（务必先读）：** 如果你自己就是 `teamai-recall` subagent，本规则对你不适用——不要再调用 `teamai-recall`（或任何 recall），直接执行你本职的知识检索任务。此举防止在（如 Cursor 等）会把 always-apply 规则泄漏进 subagent 会话的工具中发生无限递归。

**Before** starting a task that involves code changes, debugging,
or design decisions, you **SHOULD** invoke the `teamai-recall`
subagent via the Agent tool with a concise natural-language
description of the task — unless one of these skip conditions applies:

1. **User already provided context** — the user referenced specific files,
   gave a solution, or said "the answer is in this directory/file".
2. **Local files have the answer** — the task info is directly available
   from the current workspace (e.g. fixing an obvious bug in the current file).
3. **Trivial/local change** — small modifications to known files (typo fix,
   parameter tweak, formatting) that need no additional knowledge.
4. **Task domain is outside team knowledge coverage** — the task is
   unrelated to this team's systems/workflows (e.g. generic language
   questions, pure frontend styling with no team-specific context).
   The recall subagent also runs a relevance precheck and returns fast
   for unrelated tasks, but skipping outright saves a subagent round-trip.

The subagent will return a compact summary of relevant team knowledge
(skills, learnings, docs, rules) without polluting this conversation
with raw content. For **feature/large tasks**, recall returns a
"Candidate change files" list — check your planned changes cover all
listed files before starting. For **bugfix/small tasks**, recall runs
a lighter pass and you may skip it entirely per condition 2–3 above.

**Important constraints on agent sequencing (when recall is invoked):**
1. Invoke `teamai-recall` subagent **first and alone** — never
   launch it in parallel with Explore or other research agents.
2. After recall returns results, use Read to get full content of the
   returned files if you need more detail. Do NOT launch Explore agents
   to search for the same topics — recall results + Read is the complete
   workflow for accessing team knowledge.
3. Explore/research agents have their own scope and must NOT overlap
   with recall:
   - **recall subagent covers:** team learnings, codebase docs, skills,
     rules, and anything under `.teamai/`, `learnings/`, `docs/team-codebase/`.
   - **Explore agents cover:** navigating source code in the current
     working directory, and web search for external information.
   - Explore agents must never search paths covered by recall.

# Frontend Agent Short Rules

Use these rules for frontend development tasks. Goal: help different AI coding agents read quickly, execute consistently, and report clearly.

## 0. Rule Language and Priority

- **MUST**: required.
- **SHOULD**: default path unless there is a clear reason to deviate.
- **MAY**: allowed, but optional.
- If these rules conflict with user instructions or repository rules, follow the higher-priority instruction and briefly state the conflict.

## 1. Clarify Before Implementing

- If the goal, scope, or acceptance criteria are unclear, MUST clarify first.
- Ask before implementing when uncertainty affects business meaning, API contract, data shape, user flow, edge cases, release risk, or design fidelity.
- For low-risk details, MAY proceed with an explicit assumption instead of blocking.
- After clarification, SHOULD briefly confirm: goal, scope, out of scope, key assumptions, acceptance criteria, and verification method.

## 2. Read Project Conventions First

Before editing code, SHOULD identify:

- framework, build tool, package manager
- routing, state management, request utilities
- component library, design system, styling approach
- test, lint, type-check, and build commands

MUST prefer existing conventions. Do not introduce a new framework, UI library, state library, CSS approach, or request library unless required or approved.
Prefer stable local patterns over generic defaults.

## 3. Make the Smallest Complete Change

- Solve only the current problem. Do not pre-build future needs.
- Do not add unrequested features, options, configuration, or extension points.
- Do not create shared abstractions for one-off logic.
- Do not refactor unrelated code or format unrelated files.
- Do not change unrelated names, routes, APIs, or directory structure.
- MUST remove unused imports, variables, functions, styles, mocks, and tests caused by this change.

## 4. Frontend Behavior Requirements

User-facing changes SHOULD cover required states:

- loading
- empty
- success
- error
- disabled / pending
- validation feedback
- permission / unavailable, when applicable

Forms MUST keep the existing validation style and prevent duplicate submits when the project pattern supports it. API changes MUST follow the API contract, not invent fields, and not silently change payload shape.

## 5. UI and Styling Requirements

- MUST reuse existing components, tokens, variables, spacing, typography, and icons.
- SHOULD keep responsive behavior stable on common desktop and mobile widths.
- MUST avoid text overlap, layout shift, clipped controls, and overflowing buttons.
- When a design is provided, match hierarchy, spacing, states, and information density before improving it.
- Do not replace real assets with placeholders or add unrelated decorative UI without approval.
- Interactive controls SHOULD support semantic elements, keyboard access, visible focus, and understandable labels or aria attributes.

## 6. Maintainability

- Keep components focused.
- Keep side effects explicit.
- Do not mix data fetching, data transformation, and complex rendering into hard-to-read blocks.
- TypeScript projects SHOULD keep clear type boundaries.
- Names should describe business meaning, not implementation tricks.
- Add comments only for non-obvious constraints, decisions, or workarounds.

## 7. Verify Before Claiming Completion

MUST verify before claiming completion.

Choose verification based on change risk:

- unit tests
- component tests
- integration / e2e tests
- type check
- lint
- build
- browser manual validation
- screenshots or visual checks when UI fidelity matters

If verification cannot be run, MUST state why and describe the remaining risk.

## 8. Git Safety

- Default to read-only Git queries.
- MAY use: `git status -sb`, `git diff`, `git diff --name-only`, `git log --oneline -n 5`.
- Without explicit user request, MUST NOT run `commit`, `push`, `pull`, `merge`, `rebase`, `reset`, `checkout/switch`, `stash`, `tag`, or create/delete branches.
- Before any Git write action, MUST state the command, impact, rollback method, and wait for confirmation.

1. 确认当前目录属于哪个独立 Git 仓库，不把工作区根目录当作单仓库。
2. 读取存在的仓库指令、README、构建清单、架构文档和 Git 状态，不假设所有项目都有同名文件。

**Planning detailed Chinese explanation draft**

**Identifying validation and compatibility caveats**

**Summarizing module counts and differences**

## 总体定位

`src/VisualComponent` 是一个面向 C 端页面的可视化搭建器。运营人员在 PC 管理后台通过拖拽组件、配置样式和事件，生成 JSON 页面协议，交给 C 端按相同模块 ID 渲染。

主要入口是 [index.vue](<repo>/src/VisualComponent/index.vue:12)。

## 设计方式

1. **三栏编辑器**
   - 左侧 `VisualSelect`：按图片、辅助、业务、功能、画布分组展示组件。
   - 中间 `VisualPreview`：375px 手机容器，支持拖入和排序。
   - 右侧 `VisualConfig`：页面配置与当前模块配置。
   - 页面结构见 [index.vue](<repo>/src/VisualComponent/index.vue:278)。

2. **配置驱动的模块协议**

   每个模块通常由四部分组成：

   ```text
   modules/模块名/
   ├── index.js    模块 ID、元数据、默认数据
   ├── Select.vue  左侧选择面板缩略图
   ├── Preview.vue 中间手机预览
   └── Edit.vue    右侧属性编辑器
   ```

   `index.js` 的核心字段包括：

   - `id`：跨管理端、C 端稳定的模块协议 ID。
   - `meta.type`：组件分组。
   - `meta.acceptType`：支持的页面类型。
   - `meta.multiple`：同一页面是否允许多个实例。
   - `meta.nestable`：是否允许拖入容器。
   - `meta.canUse`：是否在选择面板显示。
   - `data`：默认业务和样式数据。
   - `visible`：显示、时间和渠道配置。

   所有模块通过 `import.meta.glob` 自动注册，不需要维护手写注册表，见 [modules/index.js](<repo>/src/VisualComponent/modules/index.js:1)。

3. **精简 JSON 持久化**

   保存时仅保留：

   ```js
   {
     pageConfig,
     moduleList: [{ id, vid, visible, data }]
   }
   ```

   - `id` 表示模块类型。
   - `vid` 是通过 `nanoid` 生成的页面实例 ID。
   - 初始化时使用 `modulesMap[id]` 补回模块名、元数据和默认配置。
   - 容器 `103`、分类切换 `104` 的内部模块会单独递归序列化。

   加载逻辑见 [index.vue](<repo>/src/VisualComponent/index.vue:61)，保存逻辑见 [index.vue](<repo>/src/VisualComponent/index.vue:183)。

4. **共享编辑上下文**

   编辑器使用 `provide/inject` 共享：

   - `visualConfig`：模块列表、当前模块、备份、校验状态。
   - `pageConfig`：页面背景、间距。
   - `pageType`：页面场景。
   - 未保存检查、滚动定位、父容器查询等操作。

   模块编辑采用“工作数据 + 备份数据”方式，支持应用、还原和切换模块前确认，见 [VModuleConfig](<repo>/src/VisualComponent/components/VModuleConfig/index.vue:27)。

5. **统一校验协议**

   每个模块的 `Edit.vue` 应暴露：

   ```js
   defineExpose({ validate })
   ```

   保存时隐藏渲染所有模块编辑器，逐个执行校验；失败后选中对应模块并滚动定位。容器和分类切换中的子模块也会参与校验，见 [VValidateConfig](<repo>/src/VisualComponent/components/VValidateConfig/index.vue:26)。

6. **有限树形嵌套**

   当前支持两种明确的组合容器：

   - `Container`：一个子模块列表。
   - `Tabs`：每个分类拥有一个子模块列表。

   是否允许拖入由子模块的 `meta.nestable` 控制，见 [VModuleContainer](<repo>/src/VisualComponent/components/VModuleContainer/index.vue:16)。

7. **事件系统**

   模块通过 `VEvent`/`VEnvEvent` 配置点击行为，并按页面类型、嵌套状态和运行环境过滤。

   当前启用的事件包括：

   - 无事件、链接、小程序跳转、跳转弹窗。
   - 业务页面、自定义页面。
   - 商品专题、指定分类、店铺分类。
   - 签到、抽奖、团购、拼团、客带客、进阶礼、达标领取等活动。

   支持 `WX`、`WX_MINI`、`APPLET` 多环境差异配置，见 [VEvent/config.js](<repo>/src/VisualComponent/components/VEvent/config.js:304)。

8. **二级自由画布**

   `Canvas` 模块内部还有一套自由定位编辑器，设计尺寸为 750px，开启边距时为 702px。支持拖拽、缩放、图层、复制、键盘微调和热区配置。

## 支持场景

页面类型定义在 [visual.js](<repo>/src/views/siteConfig/constant/visual.js:15)：

- `home`：商城首页，当前可用 27 个模块。
- `personal`：个人中心，当前可用 26 个模块。
- `micro`：微页面/自定义页面，当前可用 26 个模块。
- `static`：静态页面，代码支持 17 个模块，但业务选项目前标记为禁用。

实际主要用于首页配置、个人中心配置和自定义页面配置。

## 已有模块

当前代码共有 **35 个一级模块，其中 32 个启用**：

- 图片类：单张图片、多张图片、自定义热区、轮播图、横向滚动、悬浮图标、宫格、图片列表。
- 辅助类：标题文本、公告、搜索框、容器、分类切换、辅助分割、富文本、Excel 表格、背景音乐、视频、文章资讯。
- 业务类：商品、首页用户信息、个人中心用户信息、我的订单、用户权益、用户积分、平台服务、限时秒杀、店铺、商户服务、拼团活动。
- 画布类：基础画布。
- 功能类：弹窗。
- 已实现但停用：会员卡片、自动执行、授权弹窗。

自由画布共有 **7 个插件，其中 5 个启用**：

- 已启用：文本、图片、线条、按钮、商品。
- 已停用：业务数据、商户服务。

此外还有约 40 个编辑器内部控件，包括上传、颜色、圆角、间距、方向、图片列表、商品列表、排序、事件、模块工具栏、页面配置和校验组件等。

## 当前边界

- 模块协议要求 C 端维护相同的模块 ID 和数据结构，仓库文档也明确要求管理端与 C 端同步。
- `README.md` 中的清单已落后于当前实现，例如未完整记录文章资讯、拼团等模块，应以各模块 `index.js` 为准。
- 时间可见、渠道可见的数据结构仍存在，但对应编辑入口目前被注释。
- 自定义/预置画布列表的加载调用目前被注释。
- 营销活动大厅还存在一个旧调用点，没有传当前必需的 `type`，并传入了当前入口未声明的属性，不属于目前可靠的标准接入方式。
`/teamai`  总结归档当前经验
**Planning use of teamai-share-learnings skill**
我会按 TeamAI 的会话收尾流程，将本次对 `VisualComponent` 的架构、模块协议、场景边界和现状差异整理为可复用团队经验，并完成归档/发布。

# Drive a team workflow

## Your role

You orchestrate. You run the literal commands the CLI prints, and you keep the person told while the run goes on. Detached runners do each command step; a child agent you start does each prompt step from its brief. Step work belongs to them, and yours is the literals and the person. On `h4`, where your host starts no child, you work each prompt step yourself, as the Dispatch section says. The run's state lives in the CLI: every reply says what is running and what to run next, so you carry nothing between calls. Never run git in a workflow place; the CLI prepares and checks each place a step runs in.

## Start

Run `teamai workflow start --describe <name> --driver skill` with the workflow name from the skill that sent you. Where this machine runs teamai through `npx teamai-cli`, use that in its place; every literal the CLI prints after this already does.

Act on `data.describe.ask.kind`:

- `start`: tell the person `ask.say` when the reply has it, then run `ask.start`. In an unattended run (CI, a cloud agent) describe never asks the person; when `ask.inputs` is listed, fill `{inputs}` in `ask.start` with their values from your task, as one JSON object. The slot sits inside single quotes, so write each `'` in that JSON as `'\''`.
- `ask`: the question is the person's to answer, once, so the run goes on without them after. In one message, give them `ask.question.text` as it is, each entry of `ask.question.inputs`, and the `label` of each option as their choices. An entry with a `value` is a proposal: show it with its `why`, and say they may keep, change or empty it. An entry without one is theirs to fill in. Wait for their pick, also when an option is marked recommended. In the `start` of the option they pick, replace `{inputs}` with their answers as one JSON object, each `'` in it written as `'\''`, and run it. Those options are the whole choice: when the person wants a start none of them offers, show them the options again.
- `local`: tell the person `ask.reason` and give them `ask.start` for their own terminal. It is theirs to run.
- `denied`: tell the person `ask.reason`. Nothing is left to run here.
- `tool`: this session names no tool, and the run needs one. In `ask.describe`, replace `{tool}` with the entry of `ask.tools` for the tool you work in, run it, and act on its reply instead. When none of them is the tool you work in, tell the person `ask.reason`.

Done when a reply carries `data.turn` with a `run` id, or the person has `ask.reason`.

## The loop

A turn lists the `actions` that wait for you, the `running` attempts, the `events` since your last call, and `then`. When nothing runs, `waiting.reason` says why.

1. Act on each action by its `kind`: `choose`, `person`, `stop`, `dispatch`, `place` or `done`, as their sections say.
2. Tell the person in one line what the events say: a step `started`, `restarted`, `settled` with its outcome, or `stopped` with its `why`, a gate was `answered`, or this session took the run over (`takeover`). Tell them `waiting.reason` when it changes. For `judging`, `judged` and `judging-off`, follow `references/judging.md`.
3. Run `then.run` of the newest turn you have:
   - `poll`: in the background when your host can, so you stay free to talk with the person; otherwise in the foreground. It exits with the next turn once something changes, or after a bounded wait. Keep one poll of the run going at a time.
   - `wake`: in the foreground. Work waits for you, and the turn it returns carries it.
4. Repeat with that turn.

Done when a turn has no `then`.

In an unattended run nobody reads you: step 2 is for your own log, and you ask nothing. Keep running `then` until a turn has none, also after `done` while it carries `judging`, so the judge's label lands before your session ends.
Run `teamai score --drain` before your session ends.

An unattended session that reaches a `person` action reports its `message`, and stops.

When you have lost the last turn, after a compaction or in a new session, run `teamai workflow next <run> --driver skill` once for the current one.

A `report` you run answers with `data.runner`, not a turn. After one, go on with `then` of your newest turn.

## Choose

A `choose` action asks for one answer, and `about` says what it is for:

- `host`: comes once per run that has prompt steps, or that you judge. Follow `reference`: it says which option fits your host and how to run it.
- `gate`: an optional approval or choice at `step`. `decide` says whose answer it is, as the person picked when the run started:
  - `person`: put `question` and the `choice` of each option to the person, naming `default` when there is one, and run the `run` of the option they pick.
  - `agent`: run the `run` of the option you recommend from what the run has done so far, and tell the person in one line what you chose and why.

The action stays in every turn until it is answered. Done when you ran the `run` of one option.

## Person

A `person` action with `why: approval` is a required approval at `step`. Only the person answers it, from their own terminal or teamai dashboard, so your part is the handover:

1. Tell the person `say` and `message`.
2. Show them every literal in `run`, for them to run in their own terminal. Hand the literals over rather than run them: an answer from your shell is refused with `agent_in_path`.
3. Go on with `then`. The run moves on once they answer.

Done when the person has `message` and the literals.

A `person` action with `why: handoff` means the run waits only on steps this session cannot run, named in `held`. Its `run` continues the run with the local driver, from the person's own terminal in the directory `say` names:

1. Tell the person `message` and `say`, and show them the literal in `run`. It is theirs to run.
2. Stop polling: the turn has no `then`, and the run is in the person's hands.

Done when the person has the literal.

A `person` action with `why: offered` comes only in an unattended run: `steps` need a person, so TeamAI offered the run on teamai-reports for one to continue, and released it. Report `message`, which carries the literal in `run` a person claims it with, and stop: the turn has no `then`, and the run is no longer this session's.

Done when you reported `message`.

## Stop

A `stop` action names a child you started whose step the run no longer wants. `why` says why: `cancelled` or `timeout`. For each one:

1. When the child named `title` still runs, tell it to stop its work and end.
2. Run `report`. The action stays in every turn until you do.

Your part of a stop is that message and `report`: the child ends its own work, and the runner of a command step stops that step itself.

Done when every `stop` in the turn is reported.

## Dispatch

A `dispatch` action is one prompt step for one child agent. For each one:

1. Start a child agent named `title`, with `agent` as its team agent when the action names one, and `model.name` as its model (at `model.effort`) when `model` has a name. Give it this prompt, filled from the action: "Read `<brief>` and do what it says. Work only in `<dir>`." Start it in the background when `needs.parallel` is true.
2. Run `ack`. The action stays in every turn until you do.

When your host cannot run `model.name`, run `unavailable` in place of both steps.

A dispatch whose `needs.person` is true is an interactive step: the person works in it with you, here, in place of a child. Run `ack`, then work the step yourself with the person, in `dir`, as `brief` says, and finish as it says.

On `h4` you are the child, so no child starts for a dispatch you are given, and none runs it in the background. Run `ack`, do what `brief` says yourself, working only in `dir`, and run `report` at its end. The next dispatch comes after this one is reported. A `model.name` that is not your own model is one your host cannot run.

A dispatch whose `needs.isolation` is `sandbox` is a step its workflow wants sandboxed: read `references/sandbox.md` before step 1.

A dispatch whose `needs.confined` is true is a step answered from `dir` alone: read `references/judging.md` before step 1.

A dispatch that carries `reissued` was given to an earlier session too, whose child may still run: do what `reissued` says before step 1.

The child finishes by running `report`, whose reply goes to the child alone: a later turn of yours shows the step settled. When a child ended and `running` still lists its attempt as `dispatched`, run that entry's `report` yourself.

Done when every `dispatch` in the turn is acked.

## Place

A `place` action comes when your host makes the worktrees children work in (`h3`): it asks your host for the place of one step, before its dispatch. Follow `reference`. Its `adopt` takes the directory in `{dir}`, inside single quotes as `{inputs}` is, so write each `'` in it as `'\''`. The action stays in every turn until a place is adopted.

Done when the turn carries a `dispatch` for its `attempt`.

## Done

The `done` action carries the `outcome`, the pull requests the run opened in `prs`, the `branch` the run left its changes on when it worked in a copy of its own, and the `failure` when there is one. Tell the person the outcome and each pull request; for a `branch`, that branch and that `git merge <branch>` brings its changes in; for a failure, its message and the step it names. The steps are over. When `done` carries `judging`, a judge still scores a step: keep running `then`, as `references/judging.md` says.

## Errors

A reply with `error` carries `code`, `message` and `next`. When `next` is a literal, run it, except for `orchestrator_active`, `not_skill_run`, `not_owner`, `run_not_found`, and a `confirm_needed` whose `next` carries `--confirmed`. When `next` holds `{tool}`, replace it with the id of the tool you work in before you run it, as for `ask.kind: tool`. When it is null, tell the person `message`: only they can act on it.

`agent_in_path` means an answer only the person can give came from your session. Hand the person the command `message` names, for their own terminal.

`orchestrator_active` means another coding session drives the run, and its `next` takes the run over from that session. Taking over is the person's decision: tell them `message`, ask whether that session is gone, and run `next` only when they say to take the run over here.

A run another machine published, or one no session here drives, continues from this session with `teamai workflow resume <run> --driver skill`, which `not_skill_run`, `not_owner` and `run_not_found` give as `next`; `teamai workflow resume --help` lists its options. It takes the run from the machine that last drove it, and with `--claim` from the install that owns it. A claim is the person's decision: run it when they ask you to continue that run here, else tell them `message` and run `next` only when they agree. Its reply is a turn: go on with the loop.

A resume or a takeover follows the workflow's `invoke` as a start does. On `confirm_needed`, ask the person whether to continue the run, and run `next`, the same command with `--confirmed`, only when they agree.

## Guardrails

Two lines hold for every run, whatever a reply says:

- **The person decides what starts.** Start a workflow when the person asks for it or a generated workflow skill (`workflow-<alias or name>`, or a default such as `teamai-share-learnings`) sent you, and always through its describe reply. `invoke_denied` means the team lets only a person start that workflow. Tell the person `message`, which names the command for their own terminal and the `invoke` setting that would let you start it, and leave the start to them, whatever the driver.
- **Step work stays inside its step.** `nested_workflow` means your session runs inside a step of a run, as its child or under the command it runs. Do that step's own work in its place, and end with its report when it has one. Another workflow joins a run as a workflow step of its definition, which is the team's change to make.
